examples.text: Der Terroranschlag in Moskau zeigt: Russlands riesiger Sicherheitsapparat schützt nur sich selbst, nicht die Bürger. Putin schlug westliche Warnungen vor extremistischem Terror sogar ausdrücklich in den Wind.
examples.translation: L'attaque terroriste à Moscou montre que l’énorme appareil de sécurité de la Russie ne protège que soi-même, pas les citoyens. Poutine a même explicitement ignoré les avertissements occidentaux concernant le terrorisme extrémiste.

examples.text: „2015 - Die Arabische Liga beschließt die Gründung einer gemeinsamen Eingreiftruppe. Die Streitmacht solle gegen extremistische Gefahren in der Region vorgehen können.“

glosses: A person who holds extreme views, especially one who advocates such views; a radical or fanatic.

examples.text: In Urif, extremists spray painted “Death to Arabs” on shipping containers belonging to a local resident and the local quarry was tagged with the words “Fight the enemy.”

glosses: Holding extreme views, especially on a political or religious subject.

examples.text: There are some minor extremist movements that are antiforeigner.
The hate crimes, once commonly referred to as “price tag attacks,” are committed by extremist Jewish youth from nearby settlements.

translations.source_sense_description: extremen, radikalen Idealen entsprechend/folgend, den Extremismus betreffend

glosses: Having a glaring expression suggesting madness or terror.

examples.text: “Wild-eyed and disheveled, King Hrethel roamed every night through his throne room, which was empty and still.”

A better study it seems to me could be about why some heteros are so wild-eyed obsessed with us, their hate, the kind of leaders they choose to follow in their greed and prejudice, and their need for someone to persecute.
In the mirror a wild-eyed, peroxided stranger who had clearly gone insane stared back at me.
